title: Pure Horn of Heaven
summary: The Horn of Heaven strategy is a punishing Counter Trap control deck built around Horn of Heaven, Black Horn of Heaven, and Grand Horn of Heaven. By placing Guiding Ariadne in the Pendulum Zone to waive all LP and discard costs, your Counter Traps activate for free while Ariadne reveals more traps upon destruction. Bountiful Artemis draws a card with every resolved negate, and Power Angel Valkyria searches replacement Fairies, completely shutting down the opponent's summons and ending their Main Phases on command.

allow.Minerva, Scholar of the Sky: Level 4 LIGHT Fairy that gains 500 ATK every time a Horn of Heaven Counter Trap is activated and recovers a Counter Trap with a different name from your GY while The Sanctum of Parshath is face-up.
allow.Meltiel, Sage of the Sky: Level 4 LIGHT Fairy that gains 1000 LP every time a Horn of Heaven Counter Trap resolves and destroys 1 card your opponent controls while The Sanctum of Parshath is face-up.
allow.Power Angel Valkyria: Level 4 LIGHT Fairy that searches any LIGHT Fairy whenever you negate a Summon with Horn of Heaven, Black Horn of Heaven, or Grand Horn of Heaven.
allow.Sacred Arch-Airknight Parshath: Level 9 LIGHT Fairy boss that Special Summons itself from your hand or GY by banishing 2 Fairies (or Counter Traps) whenever you activate a Horn of Heaven Counter Trap.
allow.Ties of the Brethren: Pays 2000 LP to target 1 Level 4 LIGHT Fairy you control and Special Summon 2 other Level 4 LIGHT Fairies from your Deck.
allow.Solemn Judgment: Iconic Counter Trap that protects your Set Horn of Heaven traps from backrow removal at 0 LP cost under Guiding Ariadne (1 copy, Limited in TCG).
allow.Solemn Strike: Counter Trap that negates Special Summons or monster effects at 0 LP cost under Guiding Ariadne.
allow.Celestial Knightlord Parshath: Link-3 LIGHT Fairy that searches The Sanctum of Parshath or Guiding Ariadne and Special Summons a Fairy from hand when a Fairy is sent to the GY.
allow.Avenging Knight Parshath: Level 8 LIGHT Fairy Synchro cheated out by Rebirth of Parshath.

main: Horn of Heaven
Original Counter Trap: when a monster(s) would be Summoned, tributes 1 monster you control (like Guiding Ariadne, triggering her search!) to negate the Summon and destroy that monster(s).
Black Horn of Heaven
Signature Counter Trap: when your opponent would Special Summon exactly 1 monster, negates the Special Summon and destroys it with ZERO LP, discard, or Tribute cost!
Grand Horn of Heaven

Signature Counter Trap: during your opponent's Main Phase, when they would Special Summon a monster(s), negates the Special Summon, destroys that monster, makes them draw 1 card, and immediately ENDS their Main Phase!
Guiding Ariadne

Scale 3 Level 4 LIGHT Fairy Pendulum: waives all LP and discard costs for your Counter Traps in the Pendulum Zone, and when destroyed reveals 3 Counter Traps from your Deck so your opponent adds 1 to your hand.
Bountiful Artemis
Core Level 4 LIGHT Fairy that draws 1 card immediately every time Horn of Heaven, Black Horn of Heaven, or Grand Horn of Heaven resolves.
Power Angel Valkyria
Level 4 LIGHT Fairy that adds any LIGHT Fairy monster from your Deck to your hand whenever you negate a Summon with any of the three Horn of Heaven Counter Traps!
Minerva, Scholar of the Sky
Gains 500 ATK and recycles a Counter Trap from your GY back to your hand every time a Counter Trap resolves while The Sanctum of Parshath is active.
Meltiel, Sage of the Sky
Gains 1000 LP and destroys 1 card your opponent controls every time a Horn of Heaven resolves while The Sanctum of Parshath is active.
Sacred Arch-Airknight Parshath
2800 ATK boss that Special Summons itself from hand or GY when you activate a Horn of Heaven Counter Trap, and searches a Counter Trap when inflicting battle damage.
The Sanctum of Parshath

Continuous Spell treated as The Sanctuary in the Sky that protects all Set Counter Traps on your field from targeting and destruction, and recycles 3 Fairies/Counter Traps from GY to the top of your Deck.
Ties of the Brethren
Special Summons Bountiful Artemis + Power Angel Valkyria directly from the Deck alongside any Level 4 LIGHT Fairy.
Rebirth of Parshath

Counter Trap that negates any card/effect at zero cost under Guiding Ariadne, shuffles it into the Deck, and Special Summons Sacred Arch-Airknight Parshath or Avenging Knight Parshath from Deck/Extra Deck.
Solemn Judgment
Limited to 1 in TCG: protects your Set Horn of Heaven traps from backrow removal for 0 LP while Guiding Ariadne is in the Pendulum Zone.
Solemn Strike
Counter Trap that negates an opponent's Special Summon or monster effect activation.
extra: Link-3 LIGHT Fairy that searches The Sanctum of Parshath or Guiding Ariadne and Special Summons a Fairy from hand when a Fairy is sent to the GY.
Level 8 LIGHT Fairy Synchro summoned from the Extra Deck by Rebirth of Parshath.
